n4435cefd1b.headline: Iran seized British tanker: reaction of European countries
n4435cefd1b.summary: Iran detained a British tanker, leading to threats of serious consequences from London and reactions from European countries.
n4435cefd1b.why: The incident affects geopolitical stability and global oil supply routes, impacting energy markets and international trade.
n4435cefd1b.why_moved: The tanker seizure raises fears of supply disruptions in global oil markets, causing price volatility and geopolitical tensions.
